# rustinion_group_build_host (Resource)

Manages a group's Build/CI host mode. When enabled, suspicious-process findings (a web server starting a shell, and similar) that come from inside an ephemeral CI job container are recorded as info and never alert: runner job containers (Forgejo/Gitea Actions `*-ACTIONS-TASK-*`, GitLab Runner build containers), containers a running CI job started and labelled `rustinion.ci.job=<job container>`, rootless containers of the CI runner's user, and containers whose name matches container_patterns. Events on the host itself and in containers that can't be traced to a CI job still alert; outside enabled groups labels are never consulted. Destroying this resource turns the mode off.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group these settings belong to.

### Optional

- `container_patterns` (List of String) Container names your CI starts (`*` matches anything, e.g. `rustinion-ci-*`); a pattern that matches every name is refused. Default none.
- `enabled` (Boolean) The group's devices are build/CI hosts. Default true (the resource exists to turn the mode on).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.
